messages.content:
You are playing Wordle. Guess a 5-letter English word.
After each guess, you receive feedback on each letter:
🟩 = letter is in the target word and in the correct position
🟨 = letter is in the target word but in the wrong position
⬜ = letter is NOT in the target word

You have 6 attempts. Before each guess, list letters you know are NOT in the target word in <eliminated> tags, then make your guess in <guess> tags.

Example:
You guess:
<eliminated></eliminated>
<guess>CRANE</guess>
Feedback: Turn 1: CRANE → ⬜🟨⬜⬜🟩  (5 turn(s) remaining)
This means: C is not in the target (⬜), R is in the target but wrong position (🟨), A is not in the target (⬜), N is not in the target (⬜), E is correct and in position 5 (🟩).
Your next response should be:
<eliminated>C, A, N</eliminated>
<guess>STARE</guess>

<eliminated>C, R, A, N, E, S, Y</eliminated>  
<guess>BORED</guess>

<eliminated>C, R, A, N, E, S, Y, B, O, D</eliminated>  
<guess>TIRED</guess>

<eliminated>C, R, A, N, E, S, Y, B, O, D, T, I</eliminated>  
<guess>GRATE</guess>

<eliminated>C, R, A, N, E, S, Y, B, O, D, T, I, G, H</eliminated>  
<guess>WATER</guess>
